sections.text_helper: Section 39.14.6 "DCMIPP IP-Plug Clientx register 2 (DCMIPP_IPCxR2)" in chapter 39 (Digital camera interface pixel pipeline (DCMIPP)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1904.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x024 + 0x10 * (x - 1), (x = 1 to 5)
Reset value: 0x00010000
Bits 31:20 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 19:16 WLRU[3:0]: Ratio for WLRU[3:0] arbitration
A client gets a portion of the total bandwidth = Ratio(client) / Sum(all ratios)
0x0: Ratio part = 1
0x1: Ratio part = 2
...
0xF: Ratio part = 16
Bits 15:0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
